summary.title: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next on Apple M5 Max (128 GB)

environment.hardware: Apple M5 Max, 40-core GPU, 128 GB unified memory
environment.power: AC power; Low Power Mode off
environment.timestamp_note: The measurement date is known; exact wall-clock times were not retained, so midnight UTC is a normalized date marker.
environment.repository_revision_note: The repository revision identifies the migration snapshot that preserved the controller-captured measurements.

interpretation.routing_guidance: Use MTP below 28K, prefer no-MTP at or above 30K, and favor no-MTP in the gray zone when repeatability matters.
interpretation.runtime_comparison_limit: Prompt processing is sensitive to cache and residency state; use generation speed as the primary branch comparison.
interpretation.crossover_limit: This is a workload-specific point estimate rather than a universal threshold. The rows are non-monotonic and outputs often diverged between routes.
interpretation.corrected_long_context_limit: These no-MTP measurements correct any implication that the earlier MTP retrieval number represented no-MTP performance.
interpretation.output_behavior: Many same-input greedy requests differed between MTP and no-MTP, and repeated requests within one mode occasionally differed despite the recorded deterministic settings. Only rows explicitly marked byte-identical should be treated as such. A visible-string grammar was rejected as a compute-path control because identical bytes can use different BPE segmentations and completion-token counts.
interpretation.limitation: These measurements characterize operational throughput on this workload and machine. Dynamic per-request MTP selection remains a documented direction, not an implemented feature.

validations.check: Deterministic short MTP vs no-MTP output
